This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Creative Pod Manager based in Brazil.

We are seeking an experienced Creative Pod Manager to lead multiple creative teams and drive strategic excellence across a portfolio of international clients. In this role, you will oversee creative strategy, performance optimization, team development, and operational delivery, primarily for Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) and e-commerce brands. Acting as the strategic bridge between clients and internal creative teams, you will ensure that creative concepts are aligned with business objectives and supported by performance data. You will initially manage approximately 3–4 creative pods, with the opportunity to oversee up to 4–5 as the operation scales. This is a leadership-focused position where your expertise will shape creative direction, strengthen client relationships, and improve team performance. You will join a fast-paced, fully remote international environment with opportunities to contribute to the growth of a rapidly expanding agency.

lists.content:
• Oversee creative strategy across multiple client accounts, primarily within the DTC and e-commerce sectors, ensuring alignment with business objectives and performance targets.
  • Analyze creative performance data, identify trends and opportunities, and translate insights into actionable recommendations for continuous improvement.
  • Guide Creative Strategists on creative concepts, directions, hooks, formats, and testing priorities to maximize campaign effectiveness.
  • Lead strategic discussions and ensure creative deliverables are informed by client goals, audience insights, and advertising performance.
  • Conduct market research to identify emerging creative trends, new opportunities, and innovative approaches.
  • Collaborate closely with media buyers to understand campaign results and translate advertising insights into effective creative recommendations.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact between clients and their assigned creative pods, leading strategy calls and providing regular updates on performance, priorities, and progress.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships, communicate recommendations and challenges proactively, and identify potential retention risks.
  • Ensure clients understand the value delivered by their creative teams and maintain visibility into ongoing projects and results.
  • Lead and manage multiple creative pods, typically comprising a Creative Strategist, Video Editor, and Creator Coordinator.
  • Coach and mentor Creative Strategists, strengthening their strategic thinking, creative judgment, and overall performance.
  • Monitor team performance, provide constructive feedback, address performance challenges, and contribute to performance evaluations and development decisions.
  • Support recruitment activities and technical assessments for new team members when required.
  • Oversee workload distribution, resource allocation, and team capacity across multiple pods.
  • Maintain weekly capacity forecasts and adjust resource planning based on client onboarding, client churn, and team availability or planned absences.
  • Ensure each pod maintains an appropriate production capacity, targeting approximately 60–70 creative concepts per month depending on workload and client requirements.
  • Identify operational bottlenecks and collaborate with Operations teams to improve workflows, productivity, and delivery efficiency.
  • Maintain high creative standards while ensuring projects are delivered consistently, efficiently, and on schedule.

    • Requirements:

  • At least 5 years of experience in Creative Strategy, ideally within a performance marketing agency or creative agency environment.
  • Proven experience working with DTC and e-commerce brands, preferably managing multiple client accounts simultaneously.
  • Experience working with brands generating eight- to nine-figure annual revenues.
  • Strong understanding of Meta advertising and performance-driven creative strategy.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze creative performance metrics and translate data into actionable strategic recommendations.
  • Previous experience leading, managing, or mentoring creative teams, ideally including Creative Strategists, Video Editors, and Creator Coordinators.
  • Strong client relationship management skills, with experience leading strategic discussions and communicating recommendations to clients.
  • In-depth understanding of creative testing methodologies, concepts, hooks, formats, and performance optimization.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced agency environment with multiple accounts, competing priorities, and tight deadlines.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to oversee multiple teams while maintaining strategic direction, operational efficiency, and consistent delivery quality.
  • Strong capacity planning and resource management skills, with the ability to anticipate workload requirements and scale team operations.
  • Professional proficiency in English to communicate effectively with international clients and distributed teams.

    • Nice to Have:

  • Previous experience progressing from Creative Strategist to Creative Lead or a similar leadership position.
  • Experience managing multiple creative pods or cross-functional teams.
  • Experience working with SaaS or mobile application clients in addition to e-commerce brands.
  • Previous experience improving internal processes, creative workflows, and team productivity.
  • Experience scaling creative operations within an international agency environment.

    • Success Metrics:

  • Creative performance and the effectiveness of strategic direction provided to clients.
  • Consistent, high-quality, and timely delivery of creative concepts.
  • Successful leadership, development, and performance management of Creative Strategists and other pod members.
  • Client satisfaction, retention, and the strength of long-term client relationships.
  • Effective capacity planning and the ability to scale creative pod operations.
  • Continuous improvement in creative processes, operational workflows, and team productivity.

    • Benefits:

  • Competitive monthly compensation ranging from USD 5,000 to USD 10,000, depending on experience.
  • Potential performance-based bonuses linked to creative pod performance and business growth.
  • 24 days of paid time off annually.
  • Four additional paid holidays: December 24, December 25, December 31, and January 1.
  • Fully remote working environment.
  • Flexible working hours, with approximately four hours of overlap with US Eastern Time preferred for client meetings.
  • Opportunity to work with international clients, primarily based in the United States and Europe.
  • Opportunity to grow professionally alongside a rapidly expanding international agency.
  • Full-time engagement.

    • Working Schedule:

  • Full-time position.
  • Fully remote, open to candidates based in Brazil.
  • Flexible working hours, with approximately four hours of daily overlap with US Eastern Time preferred.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Creative Program Manager based in Brazil.

The Creative Program Manager will lead high-priority, cross-functional creative programs, with a primary focus on Shopper marketing assets, retail displays, point-of-sale materials, signage, and packaging production. This role ensures creative projects move smoothly from initial brief and concept development through reviews, approvals, and final artwork delivery. Working closely with Creative, Brand, Innovation, Commercialization, Production, and Shopper teams, you will align creative milestones with product launches and retailer requirements. You will independently manage complex timelines, anticipate risks, and coordinate competing priorities in a fast-paced consumer goods environment. Beyond project execution, you will improve workflows, strengthen collaboration, and mentor colleagues while helping deliver creative work that supports business and brand objectives.

lists.content:
You will own the planning and execution of major creative programs, ensuring that deliverables meet strategic objectives, retailer specifications, production requirements, and launch deadlines. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Lead end-to-end planning and artwork delivery for high-priority Shopper creative programs, including in-store displays, shelf signage, toppers, clings, point-of-sale materials, and retailer-specific collateral.

  • Manage multiple concurrent workstreams and establish project-specific timelines covering briefs, concept development, design iterations, stakeholder reviews, packaging renders, proofing, production lead times, and final delivery.

  • Partner with Shopper project managers and teams across Brand, Innovation, Commercialization, and Production to define project scope, deliverables, requirements, and priorities.

  • Coordinate creative milestones with broader Shopper programs, retail media initiatives, promotional campaigns, and product launch schedules.

  • Maintain accurate project plans in Asana, ensuring clear ownership, dependencies, decisions, and progress visibility.

  • Identify risks and potential blockers early, make informed trade-off decisions, and escalate high-impact issues to leadership with clear recommendations.

  • Lead creative workflow coordination and artwork handoffs across Shopper initiatives, packaging, trade show assets, and sales materials.

  • Organize project kickoffs, working sessions, stakeholder reviews, and approval processes, ensuring feedback is consolidated and decisions are reached efficiently.

  • Coordinate with Creative leads and production partners on design requirements, print specifications, file formats, production feasibility, and delivery timelines.

  • Manage packaging render development, print proofing, pilot participation, and production-readiness reviews.

  • Ensure retailer-specific creative guidelines, asset requirements, and approval processes are reflected in project plans.

  • Identify recurring workflow challenges and implement scalable improvements that increase efficiency and consistency across the Creative function.

  • Mentor colleagues on project planning, stakeholder communication, accountability, and creative program management best practices.

  • Stay informed about retail, Shopper marketing, and consumer packaged goods (CPG) trends, sharing relevant insights and solutions with the wider team.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate brings extensive experience managing complex creative programs, strong knowledge of retail and Shopper execution, and the ability to operate autonomously while influencing stakeholders across multiple functions. You should understand how creative development and production requirements interact, and be comfortable making decisions in a dynamic environment. Key qualifications include:

  • 8+ years of project or program management experience, ideally within the consumer packaged goods (CPG) industry, an in-house creative team, or an agency environment.

  • Demonstrated experience leading large, high-priority creative programs with multiple stakeholders and concurrent workstreams.

  • Strong knowledge of Shopper creative formats and retail environments, including in-store displays, point-of-sale materials, shelf signage, and retailer-specific collateral.

  • Deep understanding of the creative development process, from briefing and concept exploration through design iterations, reviews, approvals, production readiness, and final artwork delivery.

  • Experience coordinating creative deliverables for major retailers and adapting workflows to different specifications, guidelines, and approval requirements.

  • Ability to independently build realistic and adaptable project schedules that balance creative development, technical requirements, production lead times, and launch deadlines.

  • Experience translating technical and production inputs into clear creative requirements, including specifications, file formats, feasibility considerations, and constraints.

  • Strong understanding of Shopper media and promotional workflows, with the ability to coordinate timelines and dependencies across channel teams.

  • Proficiency in Asana or comparable project management tools.

  • Strong organizational judgment, proactive problem-solving skills, and the ability to manage competing priorities with limited oversight.

  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, including the ability to influence decision-making and resolve conflicting feedback.

  • Demonstrated experience mentoring or coaching colleagues and improving team processes.

  • Working knowledge of retail and CPG industry trends and their impact on creative and Shopper programs.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative, feedback-driven environment, demonstrating ownership, adaptability, curiosity, and sound judgment.

    • Benefits:

  • Annual base salary of $125,000–$140,000, plus bonus.

  • Fully remote work environment.

  • Collaborative team culture with intentional connection across locations and time zones.

  • Opportunities to participate in cross-functional projects and in-person team offsites.

  • A mission-driven environment focused on consumer health and innovation.

  • A culture that values ownership, continuous learning, thoughtful feedback, and professional growth.

  • Commitment to equal employment opportunities and reasonable accommodations throughout the application process and employment.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Creative Strategist & Producer - Consumer based in Brazil.

As a Creative Strategist & Producer, you will shape the creative direction and execution of campaigns designed to engage consumer audiences across digital platforms. Combining strategic thinking with hands-on production, you will turn cultural insights, audience behavior, and performance data into original concepts that capture attention and drive results. You will develop compelling creative briefs, collaborate with marketing teams and designers, and produce content in the formats where your creative strengths shine. Working across paid, organic, and social channels, you will help ensure every idea is relevant, distinctive, and aligned with brand messaging. This is an opportunity for a proactive creative professional who thrives in a fast-moving environment and enjoys taking ideas from inspiration to execution.

lists.content:
You will contribute to the full creative process, from identifying emerging opportunities and developing campaign concepts to producing content and improving creative performance. Working closely with Product Marketing, Performance Marketing, design, and compliance teams, you will help deliver distinctive, platform-native work at speed while maintaining brand consistency and regulatory standards.

  • Monitor pop culture, social trends, competitors, audience conversations, financial markets, and performance data to identify opportunities for timely creative concepts.

  • Develop complete, concept-led briefs for paid static and motion campaigns, working with Product Marketing and Performance Marketing teams.

  • Translate campaign objectives into clear creative directions, including audience insights, hooks, messaging, platforms, formats, and executional constraints.

  • Pitch original creative concepts for paid and social campaigns proactively, helping ideas reach production with a strong strategic foundation.

  • Produce content for paid and organic channels using your strongest creative formats, such as memes, AI-generated video, on-camera content, or other relevant formats.

  • Support Product Marketing and Performance Marketing managers in strengthening their own briefs by introducing sharper concepts, cultural insights, and compelling hooks.

  • Use performance insights and social listening to identify new creative angles and inform ongoing testing. Performance Marketing owns test design and reporting, while you drive the creative response.

  • React quickly to relevant news and cultural moments by developing briefs or creating content directly.

  • Collaborate with Product Marketing and compliance teams to secure approvals while preserving the strength and originality of creative ideas.

  • Maintain organized briefs, creative files, and documentation so other team members can easily build on your work.

  • Deliver creative projects efficiently while managing multiple deadlines, review rounds, and last-minute changes.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate combines strong creative strategy experience with practical production skills, a deep understanding of online culture, and an instinct for performance-driven content. You should be comfortable working independently, developing ideas proactively, and adapting creative concepts to different platforms and regulated environments.

  • At least 5 years of experience in creative strategy, social media, content creation, or performance creative within a high-volume in-house team, brand, or agency.

  • Experience in fintech, cryptocurrency, gaming, or another regulated industry is highly desirable.

  • A portfolio submitted with your application, including:

  • Two or three concept-led creative briefs or campaign decks, with examples of what was produced and performance results where shareable.

  • Examples of content you have personally created in your strongest formats.

  • At least one example of an idea inspired by cultural trends or performance data that you took to market, accompanied by a short explanation of the results and subsequent improvements.

  • A proactive, self-directed approach, with the ability to identify opportunities, pitch ideas, and drive projects through delivery with limited supervision.

  • Strong awareness of pop culture, internet trends, online communities, and humor, with an instinct for identifying what will resonate with audiences and what may quickly become outdated.

  • Understanding of performance marketing principles and the elements of an effective creative brief, including objectives, target audiences, hooks, platforms, formats, and constraints.

  • A distinctive creative skill that you can execute independently, supported by examples of completed work.

  • Strong understanding of platform-specific creative requirements across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Reddit, and X.

  • Ability to interpret creative performance metrics and use data and social listening to generate new ideas.

  • Solid copywriting skills, with a preference for clear, straightforward, benefit-focused messaging without unnecessary jargon or exaggerated claims.

  • Experience or comfort developing creative concepts within regulatory requirements, including risk warnings and market-specific restrictions.

  • Ability to work quickly without compromising quality, manage several review rounds, and adapt to changing priorities.

    • Benefits:

  • Fully remote position with an international working environment.

  • Opportunity to work on creative campaigns across paid, owned, organic, and social channels.

  • Exposure to cross-functional collaboration with Product Marketing, Performance Marketing, design, and compliance teams.

  • Opportunity to combine creative strategy with hands-on content production and develop your own creative specialty.

  • A culture that values diverse perspectives, individual contributions, and merit-based opportunities.

  • Job-related skills and work-style assessments may be part of the recruitment process, with results considered alongside experience and interviews.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Creator & Influencer Manager - Media based in Brazil.

As a Creator & Influencer Manager, you will play a key role in developing and executing impactful influencer marketing campaigns for globally recognized brands. You will oversee campaign activities from creator identification and outreach to content delivery, performance tracking, and reporting. Working closely with creators, clients, and cross-functional teams, you will ensure that campaigns are strategically aligned, delivered on time, and achieve measurable results. You will manage a diverse network of influencers while supporting negotiations, content development, and relationship building. This role also offers opportunities to contribute to campaign strategy, identify emerging social media trends, and improve influencer marketing processes. You will collaborate with experienced professionals in a dynamic, international environment serving leading US-based clients.

lists.content:
• Manage the end-to-end execution of influencer and creator marketing campaigns, including creator identification, outreach, communications, negotiations, contracting, briefing, and ongoing relationship management.
  • Coordinate multiple campaigns simultaneously, maintaining strong organization, attention to detail, and consistent follow-through across all activities.
  • Manage and develop relationships with a network of 50+ influencers and content creators across different campaigns, platforms, and content categories.
  • Monitor campaign timelines, deliverables, approvals, and key milestones to ensure projects are completed efficiently and according to schedule.
  • Identify potential campaign challenges, proactively address issues, and communicate risks or delays to senior team members.
  • Develop campaign briefs, creator guidelines, messaging frameworks, and supporting materials based on client objectives and brand requirements.
  • Review creator-generated content to ensure alignment with campaign strategies, brand guidelines, messaging requirements, and applicable FTC disclosure regulations.
  • Provide constructive feedback to creators and internal stakeholders, supporting content improvements and quality assurance, with final approvals overseen by senior team members.
  • Identify emerging creator trends, new platforms, and innovative content opportunities to strengthen campaign planning and execution.
  • Build, maintain, and expand the creator network by identifying and evaluating potential influencers based on audience relevance, content quality, campaign objectives, and performance.
  • Maintain accurate creator databases, campaign records, relationship histories, and deliverable documentation.
  • Support campaign reporting and performance analysis, developing tracking templates, data-entry processes, and reporting documentation.
  • Analyze campaign results to identify trends, insights, performance opportunities, and recommendations for future optimization.
  • Assist with contract preparation and related administrative documentation, ensuring accuracy and completeness before senior approval.
  • Collaborate with Creative, Paid Media, SEO, Strategy, and other internal teams to integrate influencer campaigns into broader marketing initiatives.
  • Participate in internal and client meetings, confidently communicating campaign progress, recommendations, insights, and new ideas.
  • Contribute to strategic discussions, translating client objectives into effective creator marketing initiatives.
  • Act as an internal resource for influencer marketing platforms and tools, helping establish best practices and efficient campaign management workflows.
  • Train and support new team members in the use of influencer marketing tools, systems, and processes.
  • Provide guidance and mentorship to Coordinators and Associate Managers, promoting consistent standards and high-quality campaign delivery.

    • Requirements:

  • 3–5 years of professional experience in influencer marketing, creator marketing, social media marketing, account management, or a related field.
  • Hands-on experience managing influencer and creator marketing campaigns, with a strong understanding of the entire campaign lifecycle, from creator identification and outreach to content delivery, reporting, and campaign completion.
  • Proven ability to build and maintain professional relationships with creators, clients, and internal stakeholders through clear, effective communication.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple campaigns, deadlines, deliverables, and creator relationships simultaneously.
  • Experience using influencer marketing platforms, campaign management tools, tracking systems, and reporting solutions.
  • Excellent attention to detail and the ability to anticipate, identify, and resolve campaign-related challenges proactively.
  • Understanding of influencer advertising disclosure requirements, including FTC guidelines and industry best practices.
  • Confidence participating in meetings, presenting ideas, sharing recommendations, and contributing to campaign strategy discussions.
  • Strong interest in social media, creator culture, emerging digital platforms, and evolving influencer marketing trends.
  • Ability to work collaboratively across multidisciplinary teams while managing responsibilities independently and meeting deadlines.
  • Excellent communication, relationship-building, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.

    • Nice to have:

  • Hands-on experience with influencer marketing platforms such as CreatorIQ, Traackr, Aspire, GRIN, or similar tools.
  • Previous experience working in a marketing or creative agency, particularly in environments involving multiple clients and fast-paced campaign schedules.
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams, including Paid Media, SEO, Creative, and Strategy.
  • Previous experience managing large-scale creator programs or coordinating 50+ influencers across multiple campaigns.
  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Public Relations, or a related discipline.
  • Strong knowledge of emerging creator trends, social media platforms, influencer marketing strategies, and FTC compliance requirements.
  • Experience mentoring, training, or supporting junior team members.
  • A proactive mindset with the ability to identify opportunities for process improvements and contribute to the development of influencer marketing best practices.

    • Benefits:

  • 100% remote working arrangement, allowing you to work from the location where you feel most productive.
  • Highly competitive compensation paid in USD, above typical market offerings.
  • Paid time off to support personal well-being, rest, and work-life balance.
  • Flexible working arrangements with autonomy to manage your schedule and focus on results rather than hours worked.
  • Opportunities to collaborate with leading US-based companies on innovative and high-impact marketing projects.
  • A people-centered culture that prioritizes employee well-being, professional development, and work-life balance.
  • Team engagement activities and opportunities to connect with colleagues across international teams.
  • Access to a diverse global professional network of more than 600 professionals across 25+ countries.
  • Opportunities to collaborate with experienced senior professionals and expand your expertise.
  • Exposure to multicultural teams and international marketing projects, supporting continuous learning and career growth.

We are looking for an experienced CRM & E-Mail Marketing Manager to take full ownership of email marketing for a fast-growing consumer health brand. You will play a key role in driving customer engagement, retention, and recurring revenue through high-performing campaigns and automated journeys. Working with Klaviyo, you will develop compelling email content and optimize CRM flows across the entire customer lifecycle. You will also contribute directly to subscription growth by creating targeted communications that encourage conversions and long-term loyalty. lists.content:
As CRM & E-Mail Marketing Manager, you will own the email marketing channel, combining strategic planning, hands-on content creation, campaign execution, and continuous optimization.

  • Plan, create, and write engaging newsletters and automated email campaigns using Klaviyo.

  • Build, manage, and continuously optimize automated flows, including welcome sequences, abandoned cart reminders, post-purchase communications, win-back campaigns, and sunset flows.

  • Drive subscription business growth by increasing conversions through automated journeys and developing dedicated email campaigns for subscribers.

  • Own and manage the campaign calendar, coordinating key commercial moments such as Black Friday promotions and new product launches.

  • Manage the external marketing agency, including preparing briefs, reviewing creative drafts, approving deliverables, and providing actionable feedback.

  • Monitor campaign performance and identify opportunities to improve engagement, conversion rates, customer retention, and overall email marketing effectiveness.

  • Take full ownership of the email marketing channel and proactively implement new ideas to achieve business objectives.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate is a hands-on CRM and email marketing specialist who combines strong technical knowledge with excellent copywriting skills and a proactive, ownership-driven mindset.

  • At least 2 years of professional experience as a CRM Manager or in email marketing.

  • Strong practical experience with Klaviyo, including campaign creation, automation, and flow optimization.

  • Previous experience in e-commerce, ideally within the supplements, wellness, or healthcare industry.

  • Excellent email copywriting skills, with the ability to independently create persuasive and conversion-oriented content.

  • Fluent German language skills, with the ability to write engaging and natural German marketing communications.

  • Strong understanding of customer lifecycle marketing, retention strategies, and subscription-based business models.

  • Excellent organizational and communication skills, with the ability to manage campaign calendars and coordinate external partners.

  • A high level of autonomy, initiative, and accountability, with the confidence to make decisions and take ownership of results.

    • Benefits:

  • Competitive annual salary of up to €80,000.

  • 100% remote working arrangement.

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Significant ownership and responsibility from day one.

  • Freedom to develop and implement your own ideas.

  • 30 days of paid annual leave.

  • Deutschlandticket for public transportation.

  • Urban Sports Club membership.

  • Regular team events and two company offsites per year.

  • Free access to the company's products.

  • Permanent employment contract.

  • Full-time position (40 hours per week).

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Customer Success Director based in Brazil.

The Customer Success Director will lead strategic customer relationships and oversee the Customer Success function for an innovative, AI-driven creator commerce business. This part-time leadership role combines commercial ownership, people management, and strategic account development, with responsibility for driving customer retention, revenue growth, and account expansion. You will build trusted relationships with senior decision-makers, identify opportunities and risks early, and ensure customers achieve measurable business outcomes. You will also shape the processes, performance frameworks, and operating model that enable the team to scale effectively. Working across Business Development, Product, Data, Operations, and AI/Automation, you will help embed technology and data into everyday customer management. This is an opportunity to influence the direction of a growing, fully remote organization and build a more proactive, scalable approach to Customer Success.

lists.content:
• Own customer revenue, retention, and expansion across a portfolio of strategic accounts, ensuring commercial objectives and customer outcomes remain aligned.

  • Proactively identify growth opportunities, customer risks, and early churn signals, translating insights into clear actions and measurable results.

  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior and executive stakeholders, positioning the business as a strategic partner rather than simply a service provider.

  • Lead strategic account planning, quarterly business reviews (QBRs), commercial discussions, and major customer escalations.

  • Ensure each strategic account has clearly defined objectives, accountable owners, customer health indicators, and a structured success plan.

  • Lead, coach, and develop the Customer Success team, fostering a culture of ownership, accountability, and high performance.

  • Collaborate with Business Development, Product, Data, Operations, and AI/Automation teams to resolve customer challenges and deliver on commitments.

  • Design and implement scalable Customer Success processes covering onboarding, account health, reporting, customer lifecycle management, and churn prevention.

  • Leverage CRM systems, data, and AI-powered automation to improve visibility, streamline workflows, and allow the team to focus on high-value customer interactions.

  • Act as the voice of the customer, bringing feedback and insights into product development, commercial strategy, and operational priorities.

    • Requirements:

  • 10+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Strategic Accounts, or a comparable commercial leadership role.

  • Proven track record of owning and improving customer revenue, retention, and/or account expansion.

  • Demonstrated experience managing high-value or enterprise customers and building strong relationships with senior stakeholders and executive decision-makers.

  • Previous people leadership experience, including the ability to coach, challenge, motivate, and develop high-performing teams.

  • Strong commercial judgment and analytical skills, with the ability to interpret account performance, identify opportunities, and address customer risks.

  • Excellent communication, negotiation, relationship-building, and stakeholder-management skills.

  • A strong ownership mindset, proactive approach, and ability to make sound decisions in a fast-moving environment where priorities may change.

  • Preferred qualifications: Hands-on experience with CRM or Customer Success platforms, along with an interest in AI, automation, and technology-enabled approaches to Customer Success.

  • Candidates who do not meet every listed preference are still encouraged to apply if they bring relevant experience and the ability to make an impact.

    • Benefits:

  • Work arrangement: Fully remote, with the flexibility to work from anywhere.

  • Employment type: Part-time leadership opportunity.

  • Strategic ownership: Direct responsibility for customer revenue, retention, account growth, and team performance.

  • Opportunity to shape the function: Play a central role in defining and developing the Customer Success strategy and operating model as the organization grows.

  • AI-first environment: Work within a business built around seven specialized AI agents, with data and automation integrated into everyday operations.

  • Cross-functional impact: Collaborate with teams across Business Development, Product, Data, Operations, and AI/Automation.

You will be responsible for handling customer inquiries, troubleshooting technical issues, managing support tickets, and ensuring timely resolutions. lists.content:

  • Diagnose, investigate, and resolve customer issues by following established procedures, support playbooks, and troubleshooting scripts.
  • Identify complex technical or operational cases that require escalation to higher support tiers, ensuring appropriate follow-up and communication.
  • Manage support tickets throughout their lifecycle, monitoring progress and ensuring timely and effective resolutions.
  • Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, troubleshooting steps, reported issues, and resolution outcomes.
  • Identify recurring problems and emerging trends, helping improve support documentation and troubleshooting procedures.
  • Participate in quality assurance (QA) reviews and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance service quality and operational efficiency.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure customer concerns are addressed effectively and the overall support experience remains consistent.

    • Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree, preferably in Information Technology or a related technical field.
  • Fluent English, with strong verbal and written communication skills to support customers in the United States.
  • Previous experience in customer support, technical support, customer service, or a similar client-facing position.
  • Experience with payment operations, cashless payment solutions, and/or self-service technologies.
  • Familiarity with administrative portals, ticketing systems, payment terminals, and mobile applications.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to investigate issues and follow structured resolution procedures.
  • Excellent customer service skills, including empathy, patience, active listening, and professional communication.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, particularly when managing multiple support tickets and follow-ups.
  • Ability to work independently, adapt to changing priorities, and collaborate effectively within a distributed international team.
  • Availability to work rotating schedules, including evenings, weekends, and weekdays, according to the assigned shift pattern.
  • Willingness to follow established support processes while contributing to service improvements.

    • Nice to Have:

  • Previous experience supporting electric vehicle (EV) charging solutions, charging infrastructure, or related services.
  • Advanced Spanish proficiency.
  • Experience supporting payment technologies, fintech products, or connected self-service devices.

    • Benefits:

  • Full-time employment under a Brazilian formal employment contract (CLT).
  • Fully remote working arrangement.
  • Opportunity to work with an international and multicultural team.
  • Monthly meal/food allowance of BRL 1,078.
  • Home office allowance of BRL 12 per working day.
  • SulAmérica health insurance.
  • SulAmérica dental insurance.
  • Childcare allowance.
  • Life insurance.
  • Wellhub membership for fitness, health, and wellness activities.
  • Opportunity to gain experience in the growing electric mobility, payment technology, and customer support industries.

    • Working Schedule

    All working hours follow Brasília Time (BRT – UTC-3).

  • Weekdays: 12:00 PM – 11:00 PM.
  • Weekends: 11:00 AM – 10:00 PM.
  • Rotating two-week schedule:
  • Week 1: Saturday, Sunday, Monday, and Tuesday.
  • Week 2: Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, and Friday (weekend off).

As a Data QA Engineer, you will play a key role in ensuring the accuracy, reliability, and quality of data delivered to customers across a range of web scraping and AI-assisted projects. You will take ownership of quality assurance from the early stages of project development, translating customer requirements into clear and effective testing strategies. Combining exploratory testing, automated validation, and data analysis, you will identify inconsistencies, detect defects, and help prevent quality issues before they reach production. You will work closely with developers, project managers, QA leadership, and customers to establish measurable quality standards and continuously improve testing practices. Using Python, SQL, and modern testing technologies, you will turn complex data into actionable quality insights. Joining a globally distributed and collaborative team, you will enjoy the autonomy to improve processes and contribute to innovative data solutions.

lists.content:
• Translate customer data extraction and web scraping requirements into clear, measurable testing strategies, taking ownership of quality assurance from the beginning of new projects.

  • Design and execute comprehensive test plans combining exploratory, manual, visual, and automated testing approaches according to project needs.

  • Perform regular testing cycles on extracted datasets to validate data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and reliability.

  • Identify, investigate, document, and report defects with clear reproduction steps and sufficient technical detail to enable developers to resolve issues efficiently.

  • Apply descriptive statistics, data summaries, and visualizations to assess data quality, identify anomalies, and monitor potential data drift.

  • Prepare detailed test reports and quality scores, providing internal stakeholders and customers with an accurate understanding of project quality and potential risks.

  • Clearly communicate testing coverage, limitations, unresolved issues, and remaining risks throughout the delivery process.

  • Collaborate with project managers and customers to clarify requirements, identify ambiguities, and ensure that expectations are measurable and testable before QA activities begin.

  • Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of test automation frameworks, focusing on test coverage, reliability, and performance.

  • Identify and implement improvements to QA processes and tools, including browser extensions, spreadsheet add-ons, and user-interface-based testing solutions.

  • Work closely with QA leadership, developers, and project managers to maintain high-quality standards while operating with a high degree of independence.

    • Requirements:

  • At least 5 years of professional experience as a QA Engineer or in a comparable quality assurance role, preferably involving software testing, data validation, or data quality.

  • Strong Python programming skills, ideally with practical experience using Pandas and Jupyter Notebook for data analysis, processing, and validation.

  • Basic to intermediate SQL knowledge, with the ability to write queries and work confidently with at least one relational database and its associated tools.

  • Solid understanding of web technologies and protocols, including HTML, XPath, JSON, HTTP, and CSS.

  • Practical experience designing and executing tests for HTTP and REST APIs.

  • Strong knowledge of test case design, test planning, test execution, and test data management.

  • Understanding of key data quality concepts, including completeness, accuracy, consistency, reliability, and data drift.

  • Experience working in Agile development environments, including Scrum or Kanban, and collaborating closely with software developers.

  • Familiarity with AI and Large Language Model (LLM) tools, particularly their application in generating test cases, accelerating data validation, and improving QA workflows.

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities, combined with strong attention to detail and a proactive approach to quality ownership.

  • Ability to quickly understand complex project requirements, learn new technologies, and adapt to changing priorities.

  • Confidence in maintaining high-quality standards and raising concerns when delivery timelines or project pressures could compromise quality.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

    • Nice to Have:

  • Working knowledge of Scrapy and other Python-based web scraping frameworks.

  • Previous experience developing or working with test automation frameworks.

  • Interest or experience in data science concepts, particularly as applied to data analysis, interpretation, and validation.

  • Enthusiasm for exploring AI and LLM-powered tools to improve testing efficiency and accelerate data quality assessments.

    • Benefits:

  • Fully Remote Work: Enjoy the freedom and flexibility to work from anywhere in the world, choosing the environment where you are most productive.

  • Generous Paid Leave: Benefit from 35 days of paid holidays per year, supporting a healthy work-life balance.

  • International Team: Become part of a self-motivated, progressive, and multicultural team of more than 250 professionals distributed across over 28 countries.

  • Innovative Technologies: Work with cutting-edge open-source technologies, modern tools, and innovative data extraction solutions.

  • Flexible Working Environment: Enjoy the autonomy and flexibility to organize your work in a way that supports productivity and personal wellbeing.

  • Professional Growth: Develop your technical expertise by working on challenging data quality projects alongside experienced professionals in a collaborative environment.

Working closely with Sales, Finance, Revenue Growth Management, and Supply Planning, you will translate data into actionable insights and support informed business decisions. You will play an active role in an ongoing transition from spreadsheet-based planning to an integrated forecasting platform, helping shape processes as new capabilities are introduced. This position offers meaningful ownership, cross-functional visibility, and the opportunity to influence demand planning practices in a fast-growing consumer goods environment.

lists.content:
As Demand Planner, you will own forecast accuracy and the assumptions behind your assigned portfolio. You will combine statistical analysis, commercial insights, and scenario planning to anticipate changes in demand, communicate risks and opportunities, and support the organization's monthly consensus and Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) processes.

  • Build, validate, and publish monthly demand forecasts in Anaplan for an assigned portfolio of customers and SKUs, covering baseline demand, promotional activity, new product launches, and product phase-outs.

  • Review statistical forecasts each cycle, apply appropriate overrides, document the rationale, and maintain disciplined forecasting practices.

  • Develop and compare forecast scenarios to assess risks and opportunities related to promotions, supply constraints, pricing changes, and other business developments.

  • Monitor forecast accuracy and bias, investigate variances, identify root causes, and implement corrective actions.

  • Develop launch forecasts for new products using historical analogs, marketing plans, and customer-level merchandising assumptions, then track performance against expected growth.

  • Represent the assigned portfolio in consensus forecasting and S&OP meetings, presenting forecast changes, underlying assumptions, risks, and opportunities to Sales, Revenue Growth Management, and Finance.

  • Gather and challenge assumptions related to promotions, product launches and discontinuations, distribution changes, pricing, and customer-specific plans.

  • Identify and communicate demand risks and opportunities early enough to support proactive business decisions.

  • Partner with Supply Planning to monitor inventory levels, weeks of supply, fill-rate risks, and allocation decisions, identifying potential demand and supply imbalances.

  • Analyze retailer and channel trends using internal, point-of-sale (POS), and syndicated data to understand customer ordering behavior.

  • Contribute demand inputs and scenario analysis to annual operating plans and long-range planning activities in collaboration with Finance and Commercial teams.

  • Support the Anaplan implementation through user acceptance testing, data validation, and the migration of assigned accounts from Excel-based processes.

  • Work with the Demand Planning Analyst to maintain master data accuracy, support reporting requirements, and investigate data issues affecting forecasts.

  • Follow demand review calendars and forecast lock dates while keeping portfolio assumptions up to date between planning cycles.

  • Identify opportunities to improve planning processes, reduce manual work, and strengthen forecasting reliability.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate brings 5–8 years of professional supply chain experience, including at least 1–2 years in demand planning or a closely related role. You should have experience managing a customer or category portfolio through a complete monthly forecasting cycle, strong analytical capabilities, and the confidence to explain and defend planning assumptions. Success in this role requires both technical proficiency and the ability to influence stakeholders across commercial and operational teams.

  • 5–8 years of professional supply chain experience, with at least 1–2 years as a Demand Planner, Demand Planning Analyst, or in an equivalent position.

  • Experience owning a customer or category portfolio through a full monthly demand forecasting cycle.

  • Proficiency in Anaplan, with hands-on experience using demand planning or integrated business planning platforms.

  • Experience with NetSuite or a comparable ERP system for managing order, shipment, and inventory history.

  • Advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables, XLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, and the ability to manage and analyze large datasets.

  • Strong PowerPoint skills, with the ability to prepare clear presentations for consensus meetings and leadership discussions.

  • Working knowledge of statistical forecasting fundamentals and the judgment to identify when commercial adjustments are necessary.

  • Ability to document forecast assumptions, explain variances, and communicate analytical findings to non-technical audiences.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a collaborative approach to influencing stakeholders across Sales, Finance, Supply Planning, and Commercialization.

  • Experience in a consumer packaged goods (CPG), beverage, or manufacturing environment.

  • Strong ownership, attention to detail, adaptability, and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, evolving organization.

    • Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with NielsenIQ, Circana, SPINS, or other syndicated and POS data sources.

  • Familiarity with retailer platforms such as Retail Link or Vendor Central.

  • Experience with BI and data visualization tools such as Sigma, Power BI, or Tableau.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Desenvolvedor(a) Backend Sênior | Adobe Commerce (Magento) based in Brazil.

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced Backend Developer to contribute to the development and evolution of large-scale e-commerce solutions using Adobe Commerce (Magento). In this role, you will design, develop, and maintain robust APIs and integrations that support modern, headless commerce architectures. You will collaborate with international, multidisciplinary teams, working on payment systems, authentication solutions, and cloud-based deployment environments. The position combines hands-on backend engineering, technical problem-solving, and collaboration across different technology teams. You will also leverage AI-powered development tools to improve productivity and streamline engineering workflows. Join a flexible, multicultural technology environment where innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth are highly valued.

lists.content:
• Develop, enhance, and maintain GraphQL and REST APIs using Adobe Commerce (Magento).
  • Design, implement, and maintain integrations with payment platforms and Single Sign-On (SSO) authentication systems.
  • Collaborate closely with teams responsible for headless storefront applications, ensuring seamless communication and integration with backend APIs.
  • Perform API testing and validation to ensure the reliability, performance, and functionality of integrations.
  • Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve technical issues related to development environments, infrastructure, and deployment processes.
  • Support the stability and continuous improvement of e-commerce applications and their integration workflows.
  • Use GitHub Copilot or similar AI-powered coding assistants and agent-based tools as part of the development workflow.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional and international teams to deliver high-quality technical solutions.
  • Contribute to development best practices, code quality, testing processes, and continuous delivery initiatives.

    • Requirements:

  • Proven professional experience in backend development using Adobe Commerce (Magento).
  • Strong knowledge of PHP, MariaDB, SQL, and Composer.
  • Hands-on experience developing and maintaining GraphQL and REST APIs.
  • Experience with automated testing and API validation tools, particularly PHPUnit and Postman.
  • Knowledge of Fastly and its application in e-commerce environments.
  • Familiarity with project management and documentation tools such as Jira and Confluence.
  • Experience with application monitoring and logging tools, particularly New Relic.
  • Proficiency with PhpStorm, Docker, or similar development environments and containerization tools.
  • Experience with GitHub Actions and continuous integration and delivery workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with deployment processes using Adobe Commerce Cloud or Upsun.
  • Familiarity with GitHub Copilot or similar AI-powered development assistants and coding agents.
  • Advanced English proficiency, with strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with distributed, multicultural teams.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a proactive approach to technical challenges.
  • Ability to work independently, share knowledge, and contribute to collaborative engineering environments.

    • Nice to have:

  • Knowledge of Adobe API Mesh.
  • Familiarity with Adobe App Builder.

    • Benefits:

  • Fully remote or hybrid working arrangements, with the flexibility to choose the model that best suits your needs.
  • Anywhere Office policy, allowing you to work from different locations.
  • Flexible working hours within a 40-hour workweek.

  • A collaborative, inclusive, and multicultural working environment.
  • Opportunities to work on international projects alongside diverse teams and develop your technical expertise.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Full Stack Developer (Mid-Level) | SaaS, Integrations, Automation & AI based in Brazil.

We are looking for a skilled Full Stack Developer to help evolve an existing SaaS platform in the FoodTech sector, focused on cost management and pricing solutions for restaurants. You will contribute to the development of new features, improve existing architecture, and build integrations that streamline critical business processes. A key priority will be automating electronic invoice processing, ingredient cost updates, and Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) calculations. You will also work with AI-powered solutions to improve data classification, automate workflows, and enhance operational efficiency. This role offers the opportunity to work on a functional product already used by real customers, combining technical autonomy with meaningful business impact. The position is fully remote, part-time, and initially structured as a three-month project.

lists.content:
As a Full Stack Developer, you will be responsible for maintaining and improving the existing SaaS application while developing integrations and intelligent automation workflows. You will collaborate on technical decisions, identify opportunities for improvement, and deliver reliable solutions that support the platform's continued growth.

  • Analyze, maintain, and evolve the platform's existing architecture and application code.

  • Develop new features, fix bugs, and refactor existing components, including code initially generated with AI assistance.

  • Apply development best practices covering testing, security, logging, monitoring, and code quality.

  • Build processes to import, validate, and read electronic invoice (NF-e) XML files.

  • Extract, standardize, and process supplier, product, quantity, measurement unit, and pricing information.

  • Evaluate integrations with Brazilian tax services and digital certificates when required.

  • Automate ingredient cost updates, recipe cost calculations, and Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) recalculations.

  • Implement unit conversions, data traceability, duplicate detection, and cost variation alerts.

  • Develop and consume REST APIs, preparing the platform for future integrations with ERP, POS, and inventory management systems.

  • Integrate AI APIs to match supplier products with ingredients registered on the platform.

  • Implement intelligent classification mechanisms with human review for uncertain cases.

  • Use user corrections and feedback to improve future AI-generated suggestions.

  • Build scheduled tasks and automated workflows to optimize operational processes.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate has solid Full Stack development experience, enjoys working with integrations and automation, and can independently investigate and improve an existing application. You should combine strong technical skills with analytical thinking, clear communication, and a results-oriented approach.

  • Proven experience developing and maintaining Full Stack web applications.

  • Practical knowledge of Supabase, PostgreSQL, Git, and GitHub.

  • Experience deploying and maintaining applications through Netlify.

  • Strong understanding of REST API development and integrations.

  • Experience processing, transforming, and validating structured data, including XML files.

  • Knowledge of workflow automation and recurring scheduled tasks.

  • Experience integrating artificial intelligence APIs into applications.

  • Ability to analyze, debug, and improve code developed with AI assistance.

  • Understanding of software development best practices, testing, and application security.

  • Strong problem-solving skills, autonomy, organization, and clear communication.

  • Ability to manage deadlines and deliver solutions independently.

  • Availability to work 20 hours per week for an initial three-month period under a contractor agreement.

    • Additional experience that would be considered an advantage:

  • Experience with Brazilian electronic invoices (NF-e), SEFAZ, and tax-related integrations.

  • Familiarity with digital certificates and related authentication processes.

  • Experience with ERP, POS, inventory management systems, or restaurant technology solutions.

  • Knowledge of JavaScript, TypeScript, or Python.

  • Familiarity with Supabase Edge Functions and scheduled tasks.

  • Experience with Large Language Models (LLMs), embeddings, and semantic classification.

  • Understanding of multi-tenant SaaS architecture.

    • Benefits:

  • 100% remote work, offering flexibility to work from anywhere in Brazil.

  • Part-time schedule of 20 hours per week.

  • Flexible working hours, to be agreed upon, with availability for regular team alignment.

  • Initial three-month contractor (PJ) agreement, with the possibility of renewal.

  • Opportunity to contribute to an established SaaS product with real customers.

  • Hands-on experience with AI, automation, API integrations, and data processing.

  • Opportunity to work on innovative FoodTech challenges with direct business impact.

  • Technical autonomy and the opportunity to influence product improvements and development decisions.

The Java Developer will contribute to the full software development lifecycle, from requirements gathering and technical design to implementation, testing, integration, and deployment. Working within an agile development environment, you will help build, maintain, and improve enterprise-level applications using Java technologies and modern development frameworks. The role involves developing scalable software components, integrating services, and ensuring high standards of quality, performance, and maintainability. You will collaborate closely with multidisciplinary teams, support other developers, and contribute to technical decisions throughout project delivery. You will also work with existing web systems, identifying opportunities for improvement and refactoring legacy applications. This is a fully remote opportunity for a technology professional who enjoys innovation, continuous learning, and collaborative software engineering.

lists.content:
• Participate in an agile development team, taking ownership of assigned development tasks and deliverables during each Sprint.

  • Contribute to all stages of the software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, technical design, programming, configuration management, testing, and deployment.

  • Analyze business and technical requirements and translate them into reliable, maintainable software solutions.

  • Develop, code, and integrate software components according to project specifications, using the designated programming languages, development tools, and libraries.

  • Build and execute component tests to validate functionality, quality, and reliability.

  • Perform corrective and evolutionary maintenance of software components, ensuring continuous improvement and system stability.

  • Manage assigned tasks proactively, communicating potential delays, dependencies, and blockers to the team.

  • Provide technical guidance and support to other developers within the project team.

  • Prepare and maintain technical documentation in accordance with project and contractual requirements.

  • Integrate developed components with solutions created by other team members, using the integration tools and processes defined for the project.

  • Set up and configure local development environments according to project requirements.

  • Support IT teams and client users by explaining the functionality and technical characteristics of developed software components, modules, and packages.

  • Deliver software components and perform integration testing in client environments to ensure the correct operation of applications and services.

  • Support software acceptance testing and deployment activities across client environments.

  • Provide training and knowledge transfer to clients, helping ensure effective software adoption and operation.

  • Analyze existing information systems through observation and experimentation, identifying opportunities to refactor and improve legacy web applications.

  • Completed Bachelor's degree in Information Technology or a related field. Alternatively, a completed higher education degree in any discipline accompanied by a postgraduate qualification in Information Technology (specialization, Master's, or Doctorate) of at least 360 hours.

  • Approximately 3 years of experience in software development within distributed environments, using enterprise Java technology stacks.

  • Strong knowledge of Java SE 8 or later, Java EE, Spring Framework 3.x or later, and MicroProfile.

  • Experience with persistence and database technologies, including JPA, JDBC, Hibernate, and SQL.

  • Understanding of software design patterns, MVC architecture, and three-tier application architecture.

  • Experience designing and integrating RESTful APIs and SOAP services, with familiarity with Swagger/OpenAPI.

  • Knowledge of application servers and runtimes such as IBM WebSphere Application Server (WAS), IBM WebSphere Liberty, Red Hat JBoss EAP (WildFly), and Quarkus.

  • Familiarity with development and continuous integration tools, including Jenkins, Git, Maven, and SonarQube.

  • Experience with software testing practices and frameworks such as JUnit, Test-Driven Development (TDD), and Acceptance Test-Driven Development (ATDD).

  • Knowledge of messaging technologies, particularly IBM MQ Series, IBM WebSphere MQ, and JMS.

  • Ability to understand, maintain, and refactor existing web-based systems.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a focus on software quality, maintainability, and technical reliability.

  • Good communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary teams and support knowledge sharing.

    • Desirable certifications:

  • Oracle Certified Professional – Java SE Programmer (version 5 or later).

  • CSD – Certified Scrum Developer.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Design Engineer based in Brazil.

As a Design Engineer, you will shape the visual identity and user experience of a high-impact technology website, translating complex technical products into engaging, intuitive digital experiences. You will combine strong visual design skills with hands-on frontend development, taking projects from early concepts and prototypes through implementation and launch. Working across Design, Marketing, and Growth, you will create compelling website experiences that help developers and business teams understand the value of advanced device intelligence technology. You will contribute to a cohesive design system, build interactive demonstrations, and continuously refine performance, accessibility, and usability. This role offers significant creative ownership within a globally distributed, remote-first engineering environment that embraces experimentation and AI-powered workflows.

lists.content:
You will own the design and implementation of key website experiences, balancing creative excellence with technical quality and business objectives. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Lead the design and development of core website experiences, including the homepage, product pages, pricing pages, and navigation, from initial exploration through responsive implementation and launch.

  • Translate complex technical product concepts into clear visual explanations, engaging interfaces, and interactive demonstrations that help users understand and evaluate the platform.

  • Refine typography, visual hierarchy, composition, motion, and interaction details to create a distinctive and consistent experience across devices.

  • Build and maintain reusable components, design tokens, and page patterns that connect the visual design system with production code.

  • Develop accessible, mobile-friendly, high-performance website experiences that follow modern web standards and work consistently across browsers.

  • Collaborate with Design, Marketing, Growth, and engineering partners on product launches, website experiments, and conversion-focused initiatives.

  • Take projects through design reviews, testing, release, and ongoing optimization, using user feedback and website performance data to improve usability and conversion.

  • Share ideas proactively, develop prototypes, and make thoughtful decisions that balance creative ambition, technical feasibility, and delivery timelines.

  • Explore and implement AI-powered workflows, including machine-readable design specifications, reusable skills, and internal tools that accelerate creative and development processes.

  • Help evolve the website's design system and identify opportunities to improve collaboration, consistency, and production efficiency.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate combines exceptional visual design judgment with strong frontend engineering capabilities and a proven ability to deliver polished digital experiences independently. You should be comfortable moving between design tools and code, experimenting with new technologies, and collaborating with distributed teams. Key qualifications include:

  • 6–10 years of relevant experience designing and building websites or interactive digital experiences.

  • A track record of owning projects end to end as a hands-on individual contributor.

  • An active portfolio website, GitHub profile, or relevant social profile showcasing high-quality websites and interactive experiences, with a clear indication of your personal contributions.

  • Strong visual and interaction design fundamentals, including typography, hierarchy, spacing, composition, and responsive layouts.

  • Advanced proficiency in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and TypeScript.

  • Experience building production websites with React and modern web frameworks such as Astro.

  • Hands-on experience with canvas animations and shaders, and the ability to prototype motion and interactions directly in the browser.

  • Proficiency in Figma and experience exploring design concepts through both visual tools and code.

  • Familiarity with AI-assisted coding tools and the ability to use AI-first workflows to accelerate design exploration and implementation.

  • Practical knowledge of web performance, accessibility standards, and browser behavior, including the ability to diagnose and resolve technical issues.

  • Ability to translate open-ended briefs into finished digital experiences, explain design and technical decisions, and incorporate feedback from different disciplines.

  • Strong initiative, independent problem-solving skills, and clear communication in a fully distributed team.

  • Proficiency with macOS and comfort collaborating remotely using tools such as Slack, Google Workspace, and Zoom.

    • Additional experience that would be advantageous:

  • Experience with three.js, WebGL, motion.dev, Blender, or other 3D and animation technologies.

  • Background working on technical B2B products.

  • Dashboards and Reporting: Maintain dashboards and alerts covering customer health, adoption, risk, and renewal pipelines. Ensure CRM and customer portfolio data remain accurate and reliable to support effective automation and reporting.

  • Digital Customer Journey Management: Operate and optimize scalable customer engagement journeys through automated emails, in-app messages, webinars, office hours, and help-center content.

  • Familiarity with product analytics platforms such as Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar tools.

  • Experience using CRM or Customer Success platforms such as HubSpot, Gainsight, Totango, ChurnZero, or equivalent solutions.

  • Build and lead a high-performing team: Recruit, coach, and develop senior leaders responsible for Media, Brand and Content, and Marketing, empowering them to build effective teams and deliver outstanding results.

  • Define the department's organizational structure, capabilities, priorities, and performance expectations while fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, trust, and continuous development.

  • Develop and execute an integrated strategy: Establish an ambitious marketing and communications strategy that strengthens brand positioning, advances organizational priorities, and increases awareness and understanding of the movement and its principles.

  • Identify opportunities to reach new audiences, develop creative campaigns and initiatives, and convert awareness and interest into meaningful engagement and action.

  • Shape public narratives and protect organizational reputation: Guide external communications and ensure messaging is accurate, accessible, compelling, and appropriate for different audiences.

  • Maintain trust and credibility with existing communities, major donors, senior leadership, and other important stakeholders.

  • Substantial experience leading teams through managers or senior leaders, including coaching, developing talent, building alignment, and delivering results through others.

  • Proven ability to attract exceptional talent, establish clear expectations, manage performance, and develop high-performing teams.

  • Experience working in publicly visible or reputationally sensitive environments, with the judgment and composure to lead effectively under scrutiny.

  • Strong editorial judgment and the ability to independently assess the accuracy, clarity, and appropriateness of communications across different audiences.

  • An entrepreneurial and ambitious mindset, with the ability to challenge assumptions, develop new initiatives, operate without a predefined playbook, and translate strategic ideas into execution.
